blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Trisha Tubu didn’t want to think about Farm Fresh’s past heartbreaking loss to PLDT. She stayed in the moment and took it one point at a time. In the deciding set, Tubu took charge and scored eight of her 30 points to complete a come-from-behind 20-25, 25-17, 23-25, 25-20, 17-15 win for solo third place with a 4-2 record in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. “PLDT is really a tough opponent, especially in a close match.
